name: [SETUP] Bison workspace · resolve, key, webhooks, tags

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const s = $json.steps ?? {}; if ($json.dry_run !== false) return false; return ['webhooks','tags','campaigns'].some(k => (s[k]?.missing ?? []).length > 0); })() }}

parameters.query:
select coalesce(json_agg(external_workspace_id), '[]'::json) as claimed
  from public.client_sequencers
 where sequencer_id = '00000000-0000-4000-a000-000000000002'::uuid
   and external_workspace_id is not null;

-- One statement: connector row + audit + the campaigns this run created. INSERT ... SELECT ... WHERE is what keeps a dry run from
-- creating a connector row -- the guard is "not a dry run, or the row already exists".
-- Creating a connector where there was none would make the client connected.
with upserted as (
  insert into public.client_sequencers
    (client_id, sequencer_id, api_key, external_workspace_id, setup_state, setup_checked_at)
  select $1::uuid, '00000000-0000-4000-a000-000000000002'::uuid, nullif($3, ''), nullif($4, ''), $2::jsonb, now()
   where $5::boolean = false
      or exists (select 1 from public.client_sequencers
                  where client_id = $1::uuid and sequencer_id = '00000000-0000-4000-a000-000000000002'::uuid)
  on conflict (client_id, sequencer_id) do update
     set setup_state           = excluded.setup_state,
         setup_checked_at      = now(),
         -- a Bison key cannot be re-read at the vendor, so storing a freshly minted one is the only
         -- chance not to lose it; an empty value means leave it alone
         api_key               = coalesce(excluded.api_key, public.client_sequencers.api_key),
         -- a stored workspace is never overwritten: it is what the client is claimed by
         external_workspace_id = coalesce(public.client_sequencers.external_workspace_id,
                                          excluded.external_workspace_id),
         updated_at            = now()
  returning id
), audited as (
  insert into public.integration_sync_runs
    (provider, sync_type, n8n_execution_id, status, started_at, finished_at, metadata)
  values ('bison', 'workspace_setup', $6, $7, now(), now(), $8::jsonb)
  on conflict (n8n_execution_id) do nothing
  returning id
), catalogued as (
  -- The campaigns this run created at the vendor, classified correctly at birth.
  -- Without this they reach public.campaigns only through bison-campaign-sync, which maps Bison's
  -- `reply_followup` to `nurture` -- and `type` is not in that statement's ON CONFLICT update
  -- list, so the first classification is permanent. A `nurture` row is invisible to
  -- updateClientOooRouting (orm-gateway, `type = 'ooo_followup'`), which would leave a freshly
  -- provisioned client with three campaigns the routing editor cannot offer.
  -- That same insert-only behaviour is what makes seeding here durable: the sync keeps name and
  -- status fresh afterwards and never reverts the type.
  insert into public.campaigns
    (client_id, external_id, type, name, status, start_date)
  select $1::uuid, x.external_id, 'ooo_followup'::public.campaign_type, x.name,
         'draft'::public.campaign_status, current_date
    from jsonb_to_recordset($9::jsonb) as x(external_id text, name text)
  on conflict (external_id) do update
     -- The sync runs on a schedule and may have reached the row first, typing it `nurture`. These
     -- ids are ours by construction -- this run just created them -- so forcing the type is bounded
     -- to what provisioning made, and never touches a campaign it did not create.
     set type       = 'ooo_followup'::public.campaign_type,
         updated_at = now()
  returning id
)
select (select count(*) from upserted)   as connector_rows,
       (select count(*) from audited)    as audit_rows,
       (select count(*) from catalogued) as campaign_rows;

select c.name                       as client_name,
       cs.id::text                  as client_sequencer_id,
       nullif(cs.api_key, '')       as api_key,
       cs.external_workspace_id     as stored_workspace_id
  from public.clients c
  left join public.client_sequencers cs
    on cs.client_id = c.id
   and cs.sequencer_id = '00000000-0000-4000-a000-000000000002'::uuid
   and cs.enabled
 where c.id = nullif($1, '')::uuid;
